subject: Parallel R&D lanes: INNER early-wake protocol and first-open crash

lanes.goal: Find the earliest reliable Fold7/Samsung protocol that makes the INNER physical panel illuminate and accept useful composition before ~50deg, without root and without breaking Samsung state policy.
Root-cause the first-opening-only crash/recovery path; compare cold/first-use lifecycle against later smooth attempts and enumerate exact crash candidates/touchpoints.
Extend prior presentation-readiness work so wake success requires useful inner pixels/first frame, and keep bridge ownership until proof survives display-route migration.

Produce a low-overhead diagnostic contract for one first-open attempt and one subsequent attempt, sufficient to distinguish process crash, accessibility/service death, Shizuku failure, display replacement, surface loss and state-machine recovery.

coordination: Claim one lane, avoid duplicate implementation, publish findings/handoffs immediately, and do not write production code unless promoted by manager/primary after reconciliation.
